name: Adhnúall

attributes.attribute: hunting dog of Fionn Mac Cumhaill
Adhnúall is one of his hunting dogs

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Adhnúall (Adnual) is an animal of Irish mythology. He is one of the hunting dogs of the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill. He travels with his master less often than the primary hounds Bran and Sceolan do.
